items.title: Georg Brunis Interview, 1958-06-03
items.q: In two years, that kid accomplished, and I'm telling you, you can close your eyes, he sits in at the 11-11 with me, and people rave about him.

ctx.x: Does he play with the trombone, how, too?

In two years, that kid accomplished, and I'm telling you, you can close your eyes, he sits in at the 11-11 with me, and people rave about him. I introduce him as my son. Oh, he's, that's... He's 17 now.
